environment.description: Same ECS Fargate service but origin is NOT publicly accessible. The ALB listener is configured on an internal ALB in private subnets (no internet gateway route). A CloudFront distribution is the sole entry point, configured with a custom origin pointing to the internal ALB via AWS PrivateLink (VPC endpoint service). CloudFront is configured with a Behavior that requires signed URLs using a trusted key group (key pair ID: K2JCFL3P9XRQB1). The signed URL policy restricts: (1) URL must include valid Signature, Key-Pair-Id, and Expires parameters, (2) Expires must be within 300 seconds of issuance, (3) the resource pattern is locked to '/api/v1/report/generate' only - the '/api/v1/report/preview' path has no CloudFront behavior and returns 403 from the distribution's default cache behavior which is set to deny all. Signed URLs are issued exclusively by the CI/CD orchestrator (Jenkins/GitHub Actions) after template content passes through a pipeline-level policy engine (OPA Gatekeeper) that rejects any template_override containing Jinja2 control sequences ({% %}), dunder references (__), or attribute access chains longer than 2 dots. The OPA policy SHA256 is pinned in the orchestrator config and validated before each signing operation.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, private subnets only
config.load_balancer: Internal ALB, no public IP, accessed via PrivateLink
config.cdn: CloudFront distribution with signed URL requirement (trusted key group K2JCFL3P9XRQB1)
config.default_cache_behavior: Block all (403) for paths without explicit behavior
config.preview_endpoint: No CloudFront behavior mapped, returns 403 at edge
config.template_policy_engine: OPA Gatekeeper policy rejecting {% %}, __ (dunder), attribute chains > 2 dots in template_override field
config.policy_integrity: OPA policy bundle SHA256 pinned in orchestrator, validated pre-signing
config.signing_authority: Only CI/CD orchestrator can issue signed URLs, no manual signing capability exposed
